subject: Request: tiered micro-credit & VAT residency for June spike
messages:
From: Elena Soto <esoto@larkcomms.io>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Lark Communications Billing <billing@larkcomms.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Unexpected June charge spike — request for credit and VAT handling

Hi Grace,

Hope you’re well. We just received June invoice #4321 and saw a 4.6x spend spike vs. our historical baseline. We believe several connector jobs re-ran during a migration window and caused unexpected ingestion.

Can Redwood provision a goodwill / service credit while we provide the usage logs? Also, we’re EU-registered and would like to confirm whether reverse-charge applies (we can attach VAT registration). Please advise:

- Can you issue a provisional credit (even a partial) while we collect logs?
- Will any credit be gross or net of VAT?
- Timeline to have credit reflected on the ledger?

Attaching the June invoice and the initial usage export from our end (partial). We’ll push a fuller usage_report by EOD.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Cloud Ops, Lark Communications
elena.soto@larkcomms.io
Attachments: June_invoice_4321.pdf; usage_report_June_partial.csv
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@larkcomms.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected June charge spike — request for credit and VAT handling

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sending the invoice. Sorry to hear about the migration spike. We’ll move quickly.

Immediate plan:
- I can authorize a provisional micro-credit for 20% of the billed amount as a goodwill gesture while we complete the usage audit. That will appear as a credit memo against invoice #4321 and should offset part of the outstanding balance.
- We need your EU VAT registration (or confirmation that reverse-charge applies) to decide whether the credit is issued gross or net of VAT. If reverse-charge applies, the credit will be net and we won’t re-charge VAT.
- Please send the full usage_report.csv and any orchestration job IDs you suspect. Finance will need those to convert provisional credit to a final credit.

Next steps from our side: I’ve looped in Jordan (billing ops) and Logan (finance). Jordan — please confirm the provisional credit code and the expected posting date. Logan — please advise if we need a tax waiver form or additional evidence for EU reverse-charge.

Elena, if you can attach the VAT cert to the thread we’ll fast-track review. I’ll follow up with a short memo to finance by EOD.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
T: +1 (415) 555-0198
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected June charge spike — request for credit and VAT handling

Grace / team — copying the thread below for context.

On Tue, 15 Jun 2027 at 10:05 Grace O'Connor wrote:
> I can authorize a provisional micro-credit for 20% of the billed amount as a goodwill gesture while we complete the usage audit.

Action from Billing/Finance:
- Approve provisional credit: GL code RWC-CR-PROV, amount = 20% of invoice 4321 (provisional).
- Posting ETA: provisional credit to post to the customer ledger within 2 business days after we receive VAT evidence. It will show as a credit memo, not a refund (customer may apply to outstanding balance).
- VAT handling: If the customer is EU-registered and reverse-charge applies, we will issue the credit net of VAT. We need a scanned VAT registration certificate and the billing contact's EU VAT ID. If reverse-charge does NOT apply, we will issue the credit including VAT; tax lines will be adjusted on the credit memo.

Docs required to finalize:
- Full usage_report_June.csv (to reconcile token/ingest counts)
- VAT cert (business registration) or EU VAT ID to validate reverse-charge
- Brief description of the migration window and any relevant job IDs (for audit trace)

Marissa — can you provision GL RWC-CR-PROV and confirm the accounting flow? Logan — if customer sends VAT cert, is a tax waiver form required or will scanned cert + EU VAT ID suffice for our record?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
From: Elena Soto <esoto@larkcomms.io>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Lark Communications Billing <billing@larkcomms.io>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected June charge spike — request for credit and VAT handling

Thanks — attaching the VAT certificate and the full usage report (CSV) as requested. Quick notes:

- We confirm Lark Communications is registered in Ireland, VAT ID: IE3245678W. Reverse-charge applies for services. VAT cert attached (Lark_VAT_certificate.pdf).
- The migration window occurred 2027-06-03 02:00–05:30 UTC; affected connector job IDs: job-77b2, job-77b3 (both re-triggered by config rollback). We included the full ingest lines in the CSV.
- We accept a provisional credit memo for 20% as described; please confirm net/gross treatment given reverse-charge.

Question: will the provisional credit appear on our next statement or as an immediate adjustment to invoice #4321? Also confirm whether any withholding or local tax treatment is needed on our end.

— Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Cloud Ops, Lark Communications
Attachments: Lark_VAT_certificate.pdf; usage_report_June.csv
